entries.title: Isaiah 62:1
segments: Will I not hold my peace--will not rest; from intercession with God for Zion.  Compare

. 
 
God will be inquired of by his people for the fulfilment of his glorious promises.  It is in answer to their fervent prayers, that he appears for their salvation; and in this work of intercession, Zion's watchmen are called to take the lead.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:2
segments: A new name; like that mentioned in
, denoting her new and glorious character and condition.  Compare

entries.title: Isaiah 62:3
segments:
Crown-diadem; these figures denote her excellence and dignity. 
 
  In the hand of the Lord; under his safe-keeping.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:5
segments:
Thy sons marry thee; viewed in one aspect, the church is the mother of believers, for in her they are spiritually born; in another, she is their bride, for they have chosen her, and are devoted to her welfare. This blending of figures in metaphor is natural and beautiful. 
 
The true children of Zion prefer her above their chief joy, and are willing to give both their substance and their life to the advancement of her welfare.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:6
segments:
Watchmen; the ministers of the church, which is here represented by Jerusalem. 
 
  Make mention of the Lord; rather, "put the Lord in remembrance," that is, of his promises to Jerusalem.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:8
segments:
vv 8-12. 
 
Though all the powers of darkness are combined against Zion to desolate and destroy her, they cannot hinder her triumph.  This is made sure to her by the oath of Jehovah; what he has promised he will perform in the eyes of all nations, so that they shall be compelled to acknowledge that she is "the redeemed of the Lord."

entries.title: Isaiah 62:10
segments: Go through the gates; of Babylon, in escaping from captivity. Compare

.  But we must not restrict the prophet's words to the literal deliverance from Babylon.  This is rather to be considered as an earnest and pledge of greater deliverances in the coming days of the Messiah's kingdom.
